Chapter 6905: How Disgusting

Chapter 6905: How Disgusting

“It will be a new world full of dark lives for you all to reap from one generation after another. After all, time runs out in this current scenario, either death or becoming out of control like crazed dogs from hunger.” Li Qiye said.

“So it can indeed create a new world.” Controller grasped the main point.

“Yes.” Li Qiye smiled.

The overlords’ greed erupted over the possibilities. They wouldn’t need to leave Stygian with endless harvest cycles.

“Hunger is still possible?” Guangmai didn’t care about this.

From start to finish, he hoped to become a celestial immortal. However, such a being could still die from hunger?

“Worrying about hunger now?” Li Qiye smiled.

“I only wish to have the best outcome for my brothers.” Guangmai said.

“Death from hunger is distant from immortals, but not the going insane part. Eventually, you all will become wild dogs hunting for a meal to fill your empty stomach.” Li Qiye said.

The immortals exchanged glances. In reality, they were certainly hungry, especially after seeing majestic life forces. They only maintained control since the hunger was not overwhelming yet.

They last feasted before Heaven Pit. Some managed to sneak outside and occasionally had good meals.

Recently, nothing was left in Stygian. Other worlds weren’t possible since they had consumed the isolated ones. The risk was rather high venturing far out.

“Is it inevitable?” Guangmai asked. At first, the dark path didn’t seem grim. As long as there was life and essence, they could continue to progress.

In fact, they could swallow time and karma as well. He had a deeper insight into the path compared to Controller’s group.

The problem was after becoming a celestial immortal. The resources consumed would need to be greater. Was there an end to this?

“The primordial race became wild dogs. Not to mention life, they would have feasted on shit.” Li Qiye smiled.

Guangmai took a deep breath and contemplated the future. Was this his fate as well?

“Could the heart prevent the hunger?” He asked earnestly.

“But you’re using it to rebuild this world already.” Li Qiye smiled.

“It’s best to understand the heart before using it for such a majestic goal.” He responded.

“Unfortunately, the way to stop the hunger is not the heart. Only the dao heart can do so, the only shackle to greed and desire.” Li Qiye said.

“What about severing karma?” He asked again.

“No need to fantasize any longer since you all won’t have the chance. Only death awaits but rest assured, Stygian will be rebuilt for the better.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Looks like we have nothing else to talk about.” He understood he couldn’t get more information out of Li Qiye regarding the heart.

“Indeed. However, my merciful self will give you all the options to choose how to die.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Fellow Daoist, I wonder if you can even leave this place alive.” He calmed down and waved at the other immortals.

“Of course I can, just not right now. I need to rebuild and nourish this world again by grinding you all...” Li Qiye said.

“Enough!” Bugflood Immortal Monarch shouted: “I will test your power first!”

“Boom!” He released countless vicious insects toward Li Qiye, chomping everything along the way.

“How disgusting.” Li Qiye stood still, untouched by the swarm.

He flicked one finger and no one could sense any fluctuation in power. However, it crushed the swarm in the blink of an eye.
